description: Smallest sawn lumber lintel over a door or window opening in a loadbearing wall, from Tables 9.23.12.3.-A to C of the 2024 Ontario Building Code. Source: Ontario Building Code 2024, Division B, Tables 9.23.12.3.-A to 9.23.12.3.-C, Maximum Spans for Lintels (No. 1 or No. 2 grade lumber).

floor_joists_full_width.description: Floor joists span the full building width without support (table note 3 reduction for 1 to 3 storeys).

opening_ft.description: Opening width in feet (or use opening_m). Unit: ft.

opening_in.description: Extra inches added to opening_ft. Unit: in.

opening_m.description: Opening width in metres, instead of opening_ft. Unit: m.

snow_kpa.description: Specified roof snow load for exterior walls; the column at or above it is used. Unit: kPa.

species.description: Lumber species group (No. 1 or No. 2 grade).

supports.description: What the lintel supports: attic (limited attic storage and ceiling), roof (roof and ceiling, tributary width 0.6 m max), roof-wide (roof and ceiling, 4.9 m max), 1-storey, 2-storey, 3-storey (roof, ceiling and that many storeys). The numbers 0 to 5 are also accepted.

wall.description: Exterior or interior wall (attic is always interior).
